errata_or_scope_corrections.finding: Original Cartesian mapping omits r. Wording retained and ordinary r factors explicitly restored.
Original angle definition is signed momentum ratio, negative for the original y=b>0 diagram. Magnitude separately given.
Finite holonomy is a direction angle modulo 2pi; polar frame singularity handled.
Flat coordinate image covers Rindler wedges; it is not the entire Minkowski plane without extension.
Without zero shift, original covariant G00/G0i constraint claim is false. Contravariant/formal normal projection proof and an explicit shifted-FLRW counterexample supplied.
Mixed Weyl tensor is conformally invariant; all-lower Weyl scales. Zero property remains invariant.
Given plus-sign weak metric uses phi opposite to standard Newton potential. Work follows stated metric and gradient; phi*g terms consistently discarded.
General spin formula is the leading far-zone current dipole; uniform sphere has exact exterior dipole at retained perturbative order. Interior added to make exterior assumption explicit.

Original negative g0i cross term is inconsistent with both the requested plus v cross H force and negative curl H source. Correct negative-cross-term derivation and a consistent alternative Hgrav=-curl beta are supplied; replacing cross term by positive sign restores original target equations.
